text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I invited Mei Satake out, she 
mentioned having plans for a dinner 
meeting with Chairwoman Akikawa. Instead, 
she ended up inviting me to join them at 
the table.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
It's a French restaurant Yayoi frequents. 
We often go there together, too.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Deduction! I figured Mei must be yearning 
for a taste of home right about now.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if I don't give her a chance to 
catch her breath like this, Mei would keep 
running forever...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! I can hear you! Look at little 
Yayoi, all grown up and talking back!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
You truly look like a seasoned mentor now. 
Impressive, truly impressive!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Don't think I'll be 'Little Yayoi' 
forever, got it? Now, let's head in!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! Delicious! This beef fillet en croûte 
is so good, my cheeks might just fall off!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Trainer <username>, you barely seem to have 
touched your food...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having it pointed out left me at a loss 
for words. However, I decided to be 
completely honest here...
choice_data_list:
To tell the truth, I still haven't 
mastered French dining etiquette……

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
What, so that's all it was! I was worried 
you were feeling sick!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me. I will teach you table 
manners as many times as it takes until 
all your worries vanish!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Yayoi displays such flawless etiquette 
now, but I used to look after her back in 
the day!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Nostalgia, hah――there were times like 
that. Now then, Trainer <username>! I'll explain as 
we go, so eat with peace of mind!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After having them review my etiquette and 
finally getting the hang of it...

text_block_list.name: Waiter
text_block_list.text: Pardon me. Allow me to clear your plates.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I looked at Mei Satake's plate――and saw 
food left over! Could it be she couldn't 
finish it because she spent the whole time 
teaching me table manners……?!
choice_data_list: Excuse me, could you hold on that plate?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. Bwahaha! Whew, ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hmph…… It is not that I couldn't finish 
it! I deliberately left some on purpose!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much time passes, I've still 
got the palate of a kid, so I'm quite the 
picky eater... Every now and then, doing 
thisââ

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Yayoi, stop!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, could you wait for me? I'll 
finish eating right away...!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, what a pathetic display I've put 
on...!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...I have a favor to ask, seeing the 
potential in you.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: , I'm already treated like a kid as it is.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I'm currently working to overcome the bad 
habit that makes it worse! Until I've 
conquered it, keep this a secret from 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Please...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Mei Satake plead so desperately was 
somehow amusing and endearing…… Either 
way, we now shared a secret.
